global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with crisp menma and shredded cabbage. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a dark, textured surface under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Black textured table surface with subtle grain, oval shape, smooth finish, and faint light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, blue-rimmed edge.
regions.soup: The miso broth is creamy yellow, textured with bubbles and floating ingredients, showing surface tension and slight sheen.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slight yellow stain near tip.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture and subtle surface ridges.
